content: Older adults residing in long-term care (LTC) facilities may exhibit irregular eating patterns, which can significantly increase their risk of hypoglycemia. To effectively manage diabetes in this population, it is essential to implement individualized meal planning. This approach not only helps in maintaining glycemic control but also accommodates personal food preferences and ensures adequate nutritional intake. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) can serve as a valuable tool for detecting and managing hypoglycemia in LTC settings, particularly in situations where conducting formal evaluations may be difficult or impractical.
